statement: You are given an integer array nums. A subsequence keeps some of the elements in their original order, and it is strictly increasing if each element is larger than the one before it.
Return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence of nums.

examples.explanation: One longest increasing subsequence is 2, 3, 7, 18, with length 4.
The values only decrease, so any single element is a longest increasing subsequence.
Increasing means strictly larger. Equal values cannot follow each other, so the longest increasing subsequence is any single 7.
